title: Multi-Tenant Feature Flags & Quotas
brief: As a platform admin, I want each tenant to be able to customize its feature flags and limits, so that tenants can differ from the organization defaults where they need to.

steps.summary: Add tenant configuration types and organization defaults
steps.narration: I'll start with the tenant configuration types and the organization defaults.
Now the main logic: combining a tenant's own settings with the organization defaults.

steps.summary: Add quota checks and a quota wrapper
steps.narration: Next I'm adding the quota checks and a wrapper that applies them.

steps.summary: Add unit tests for configuration and quotas
steps.narration: Finally, unit tests for the configuration and the quotas.

probe.question: The organization default is allowExport = true and the tenant override is allowExport = false. What does getEffectiveConfig() return for allowExport?

items.question: A tenant's rate limit override is set to 0 while the organization default is 100. What happens to that tenant's requests?
options: All of the tenant's requests are blocked
Requests are still allowed, up to the organization default of 100
Requests are allowed but logged for review
Only the first request is blocked

items.question: A tenant has no overrides and has already made 100 requests. What happens to its 101st request?
options: It is blocked with the reason "rate limit reached"
It is allowed; the counter resets
It is allowed but logged for review
It is blocked only if exports are disabled

items.question: A tenant overrides only its number of seats, setting it to 25. Which settings does it end up with?
options: plan: team, allowExport: true, rateLimit: 100, seats: 25
plan: team, allowExport: true, rateLimit: 0, seats: 25
Only seats: 25; every other setting is undefined
plan: team, allowExport: false, rateLimit: 100, seats: 10
